profileEditor.title: Edit profile
profileEditor.name: Name
profileEditor.orchestratorHint: Started by Play. Delegates only — never writes code.
profileEditor.slotsHint: A blueprint, not a fixed head count — the orchestrator decides within the limits.
profileEditor.noSlots: No roles yet. Without a slot the orchestrator cannot start anyone.
profileEditor.maxTitle: Maximum number of concurrent instances of this slot
profileEditor.customRolePromptPlaceholder: What this role does — and what it must not touch.
profileEditor.autoSubmitTasksHint: Vertragus presses Enter for the agent. Off: the task stays in the CLI’s input field and has to be submitted by hand.
profileEditor.zonesTitle: Draw window zones directly on the screen
profileEditor.zonesNewHint: Save first — zones belong to a profile that already exists.
profileEditor.deleteConfirm: Really delete profile “{{name}}”? Running workspaces are not affected.
profileEditor.unknownProfile: This profile does not exist (any more).
profileEditor.modelsEmpty: No models found — free text still works
profileEditor.modelsNoMatch: No match — typed ids stay allowed.

errors.name: Please enter a name.
errors.maxCount: Please enter a number from 1 up (or leave it empty).
errors.maxSubagents: Please enter a number from 1 up (or leave it empty).

providerEditor.title: Edit provider
providerEditor.presetNotice: You are editing the built-in preset — “Reset to preset” brings it back.
providerEditor.resetConfirm: Reset “{{label}}” to the shipped preset? Every change to this provider is lost.
providerEditor.label: Display name
providerEditor.idHint: Referenced by profiles and cannot be changed later.
providerEditor.commandHint: Program name, looked up on PATH — not a shell line, no arguments.
providerEditor.enabledHint: Off: the provider stays stored but can no longer be selected.
providerEditor.argsHint: One per line. Ollama for example: “run”.
providerEditor.yoloArgsHint: One per line. Only subagents get them — an orchestrator never does, whatever stands here.
providerEditor.modelArgHint: Empty = the model is appended positionally after the arguments.
providerEditor.versionArgsHint: One per line. This is how Vertragus checks whether the CLI can start.
providerEditor.effortTemplateHint: Must contain {effort} — the value is inserted verbatim.
providerEditor.authLoginArgsHint: One per line. Starts the CLI’s login in a terminal.
providerEditor.authStatusArgsHint: One per line. Leave empty when the CLI has no status command.
providerEditor.promptPtyHint: Without a launch flag: Vertragus types the prompt into the terminal after the ready handshake.
providerEditor.promptAgentFileHint: Vertragus writes an agent file with a YAML head; its text REPLACES the default prompt.
providerEditor.mcpStrictArgHint: Limits the CLI to exactly this file. Empty = no strict mode.
providerEditor.mcpAllowedToolsArgHint: Set for the orchestrator only; subagents run without an allowlist.
providerEditor.mcpCodexHint: Codex has no config file: url, required and enabled_tools travel along as -c overrides.
providerEditor.mcpKimiHint: Kimi has no flag: Vertragus creates .kimi-code/mcp.json in the agent’s working directory.
providerEditor.mcpCursorHint: Cursor has no flag: Vertragus merges vertragus into .cursor/mcp.json and launches with --approve-mcps.
providerEditor.mcpGrokHint: Grok has no flag: Vertragus merges [mcp_servers.vertragus] into .grok/config.toml and allows the tools via --allow.
providerEditor.mcpNoneHint: The agent can report nothing. Vertragus warns the orchestrator after 120 s without output.
providerEditor.discoveryArgsHint: One per line, e.g. “models” or “provider / list / --json”.
providerEditor.discoveryPathHint: ~ is resolved to the user folder.
providerEditor.discoveryJsonPathHint: e.g. models[].name — leave empty for a flat list.
providerEditor.seedModelsHint: One per line. Rolling aliases of the CLI only (opus, sonnet) — never a specific release.
providerEditor.deleteConfirm: Really delete provider “{{label}}”? Profiles that use it can no longer be started afterwards.
providerEditor.unknownProvider: This provider does not exist (any more).
providerEditor.verifiedDrift: Preset last verified against {{verified}}; installed is {{installed}}.

errors.label: Please enter a display name.
errors.id: Please use an id of letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.
errors.url: Please enter a complete url (with http:// or https://).
errors.args: Too many or too long arguments.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Applies to Vertragus as a whole.
settings.agentPolicyAskUser: Ask user — the CLI asks in its terminal
settings.agentPolicyAskOrchestrator: Ask orchestrator — risky actions need its approval
settings.agentPolicyHint: Yolo: full autonomy. Ask user: the CLI's own permission prompt waits for you in the agent terminal (hard boundary). Ask orchestrator: subagents run autonomously, but their contract requires the orchestrator's approval before risky actions (soft boundary — see the README threat model).
settings.hotkeyHint: Electron format: join modifiers with +, e.g. Control+Alt+V. Takes effect right after saving.
settings.autostartHint: Vertragus starts automatically after you sign in.
settings.autostartUnsupported: Installed app only: in a dev run the login item would point at the Electron binary.
settings.updateChannelHint: main delivers fixes fastest, stable only tagged versions.
settings.themeHint: Takes effect immediately — in this window and every other one.
settings.localeHint: Takes effect immediately — in this window and in every other one.

updateStatus.disabled: Self-updates only run in the installed app.

errors.hotkeyNoModifier: A global hotkey needs at least one modifier (Control, Alt, Shift, Super …).
errors.hotkeyNoKey: The actual key after the last + is missing.
errors.hotkeyUnknownKey: “{{key}}” is not a key Electron knows.

settings.translucentHint: Windows sit over the desktop as glass. Off: everything is fully opaque.
settings.translucentOffHint: Transparency is off. The sliders keep their values and apply again as soon as you switch it back on.
settings.glassLadderHint: Rest <= hover <= focus - smaller values are lifted automatically.

glassSlider.restOpacityHint: How visible a window is while nothing points at it.
glassSlider.hoverOpacityHint: How visible a window becomes once the mouse is over it.
glassSlider.focusOpacityHint: Applies to agent windows that are being typed in.
glassSlider.surfaceTransparencyHint: 0 % paints the surfaces themselves solid, 100 % is the designed glass - independent of the opacity above.

settings.remoteEnableHint: Drive Vertragus from your phone or browser over your tailnet.
settings.remoteEnableOffHint: Off. Only your local PC can drive agents.
settings.remoteTailscaleMissing: No Tailscale network found. Vertragus binds to your tailnet by default.
settings.remoteBindHint: Which address Vertragus listens on. Tailscale is recommended.
settings.remoteAllWarning: 0.0.0.0 makes Vertragus reachable on ALL interfaces — including your local network without Tailscale. Choose deliberately.
settings.remoteAllConfirm: I understand the risk and want to listen on all interfaces.
settings.remoteScan: Scan this QR code with your phone to pair:
settings.remotePersistHint: This link stays the same across restarts. Only “Generate a new pairing code” changes it and disconnects every device.
settings.remoteRegenerateHint: Disconnects every paired device and changes the QR code. Not needed after a normal restart.
settings.remoteWarnExec: Connected devices can start agents in YOLO mode — that is code execution on this PC. Only trust devices you would trust with the machine itself.

zones.empty: No zone on this screen yet — pick a role below.
zones.pickHint: Which screen should Vertragus spread windows across? You can draw zones or auto-layout next.
